Return the relevant licensed MAK consultant and contact destination. Do not collect case facts, assess eligibility, book, pay, send messages,

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_mak_topic_sources, get_mak_rcic_contact · Private data: get_mak_topic_sources, get_mak_change_ledger, get_mak_rcic_contact · Public sink: get_mak_rcic_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_mak_topic_sources, get_mak_rcic_contact · Private data: get_mak_topic_sources, get_mak_change_ledger, get_mak_rcic_contact · Public sink: get_mak_rcic_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_mak_change_ledger" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this read-only tool when a user asks what Canadian immigration source MAK last verified or rechecked, what an official source establishes, or for a dated source check on Canadian Experience Class work experience, Express Entry documents or personalized checklists, IRPA section 16(1), or work-per" → after: "Use this read-only tool when a user asks what Canadian immigration source MAK last verified or rechecked, what an official source establishes, or for a dated source check on Canadian Experience Class work experience, Express Entry documents, the announced November 2026 Express Entry CRS change, IRPA"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
